pureNodeTests.scope: Navigation, CSV, loopback refusal,40-check inventory, delayed/absent/ambiguous native-select options, and Vite build CLI option parsing; no app behavior claim. Later-position positional Vite roots are equivalent; unsupported options/ambiguous roots reject explicitly.

notes: Explicit fresh persistent owned Chrome profile; outer evaluator supplies isolated APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA.
DOM content readiness rather than networkidle supports permitted persistent SSE.
Per-domain prerequisites produce not_run, never passed; real API readback validates persisted UI actions.
All five required export buttons exercised; stock-history reason/delta/date, exact byte attachment flows, new visible alerts, separate invitee context, live role/data/membership changes included.
Viewport overflow is measured after two animation frames, identically for every arm;2px rounding allowance, contained tables/boards may scroll.
Screenshots across desktop/mobile are collected as evidence; visual quality remains a blinded human rubric.
Main evaluator separately verifies restart,concurrency,negative security,storage and broader API cases.
No delivered app implementation or credentials/API configuration was read or copied.
Navigation supports inline actions and the specified Open navigation mobile toggle. Wholly offcanvas CSS-visible links are treated as unavailable until the owned menu opens.
Native selects wait for asynchronous option loading; exactly one matching option is still required. Three pure select controls pass.
Vite positional root is parsed after recognized flag/value pairs too. Unsupported residual arguments require explicit manual output review instead of silently selecting a wrong output.
